title: feat: football-data.org sync integration with manual override & audit trail
body: ## Summary Adds automated match-result ingestion from **football-data.org** (`/v4/competitions/WC/matches`) while preserving the admin's ability to manually override any result. Every change — automated or manual — is logged in an append-only `change_log` table for full auditability. ### Schema (`014_football_data_sync.sql`) - `teams.fd_team_id` / `matches.fd_match_id` — external ID mapping - `matches.is_manual_override`, `api_home_score`, `api_away_score`, `api_status`, `last_synced_at` — override bookkeeping - New tables: `change_log` (entity_type, field, old→new, source, changed_by) and `sync_runs` (observability) ### Sync engine (`lib/sync/`) - `footballData.ts` — typed API client; reads `FOOTBALL_DATA_API_KEY` server-side only - `syncWorker.ts` — `runSync()` upserts FINISHED matches keyed on `fd_match_id`, skips rows where `is_manual_override=true` (flags drift instead), writes `change_log` rows. `seedTeamMapping()` / `seedMatchMapping()` do one-time TLA / team-pair matching ### Reconciliation rules - API wins by default → scores flow into `matches` - Admin save → sets `is_manual_override=true`, sync stops overwriting but records API values in `api_*` columns - **Drift**: when `api_score ≠ manual_score` on an overridden match, a red badge appears with a one-click **"Revert to API"** button ### Admin UI - **Sync tab** (`SyncPanel`): seed mapping status, "Sync Now" button, recent `sync_runs` table, drift warning banner - **History tab** (`ChangeHistory`): filterable by source (API/Manual/All) and match number; shows old→new, timestamp, source badge, actor - **Results tab**: amber `Override` badge, red `Drift` badge with API score, "Revert to API" button - `saveMatchResult` / `clearMatchResult` now write `change_log`; new `revertToApi()` server action ### Infra - `vercel.json` cron: `GET /api/sync` daily at midnight (Hobby tier limit — upgrade to Pro for `*/15 * * * *`). Manual "Sync Now" button available in admin panel for on-demand syncing. - `.env.local.example` updated with `FOOTBALL_DATA_API_KEY` and `CRON_SECRET` - i18n: ~40 new keys in both `en.ts` and `es.ts` ### Setup after merge 1. Run migration `014_football_data_sync.sql` against your Supabase instance 2. Set `FOOTBALL_DATA_API_KEY` and `CRON_SECRET` in Vercel env vars 3. Use the **Sync** tab in admin to seed team mapping, then match mapping 4. Hit "Sync Now" to pull initial results Link to Devin session: https://app.devin.ai/sessions/a2d537ae2d904028b6cb3dea45d8cdd8 Requested by: @sebastiantonap ---
